title: GenAI Chatbot
description: A simple chatbot that uses AI to answer questions using a serverless architecture.
fulldescription: This prototype launches a complete chat application. It uses Amazon S3 to host the website interface you see in your browser. When you send a message, it goes through Amazon API Gateway to an AWS Lambda function. This function sends your text to Amazon Bedrock, which generates the AI response. The conversation history is saved in Amazon DynamoDB so you can keep track of what was said. It is a serverless setup, meaning you do not pay for servers when no one is using it.
